project.name: graphrag
project.description: GraphRAG is a Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 REST API for schema-managed knowledge bases in Neo4j, document ingestion, LLM-based graph extraction, and schema-aware Cypher Q&A. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and contributor guidance to understand the REST API scope, Neo4j-backed knowledge base model, and safety constraints.

tour.title: Application Bootstrap
tour.description: Follow the Spring Boot entry point and configuration resources that initialize the service and profiles.

tour.title: Schema and Knowledge Base API
tour.description: Inspect the controller, registry service, schema parser, and repositories that enforce immutable schema identity and active schema rules.

tour.title: Document Ingestion Pipeline
tour.description: Trace upload, storage, parsing, chunking, embedding, and graph extraction from the document controller into service and graph components.

tour.title: Query Flow
tour.description: Review Cypher generation, validation, and execution, including read-only safeguards and query controller endpoints.

tour.title: Verification Coverage
tour.description: Finish with the integration and focused service tests that exercise the end-to-end flow and cleanup behavior.
